auth_policy: Only generic injected DSMACK_SENTINEL_ENDPOINT, mapped to ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL and run-local ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN; no provider credentials in workload
context_policy: One new container, empty cwd and HOME, no history/tools/MCP/hooks/plugins/candidate/other suites for each judge; same pinned base/spec projection only
observed_model_policy: exact requested ID in CLI init and every assistant message; no alias or fallback
policy: NEW serialization task only; no retry, repair or reinterpretation of prior failed tasks
qualification: Actual selected one-file OCI derivation independently verified and digest-pulled; sourcee761 canonical serialization changes representation only. Paid-image native qualification requires its own fresh original execution proof. Metadata grants no funding or provider authority.
resource_scope: Native VM1vCPU/4096MiB/600s; no independent Darwin/container AS/RSS or PID hardcap qualification claimed.

serialization.authorship: Raw bytes are model-emitted; canonical suite bytes and the serialization record are deterministic measured-runtime outputs, not model-authored byte claims.
serialization.bounds: Both raw and canonical suite bytes must independently be 1..262144; duplicate keys, floats, nonfinite values, unsafe/noncanonical integers and invalid Unicode are refused. Arrays/actions/IDs/text values are unchanged; deterministic JSON encoding may change whitespace, object key order and equivalent escape spellings only; no Unicode normalization.
serialization.host_recompute: Re-run the pinned original model observer over authenticated transcript.jsonl; its exact raw result bytes must equal suite-model-raw.txt. Re-run pinned generator canonicalize_suite(raw), require byte equality with suite.json, and require canonical suite_serialization_record(raw,suite) byte equality with suite-serialization.json. Then apply the unchanged strict Node suite contract and compare its returned bytes exactly. Keep the original CLI/model, prompt/snapshot, commitment, outcome and resource checks. No content repair, extra model call or judge retry.

stage_input_relation: Each independent request pins the same base tree, spec and generator snapshot digests; suite hashes are outputs
